import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Fetch PM10 concentrations for all stations at 2025-10-05 14:00:00
query = text("""
SELECT station_id, pm10, aqs.name_en
FROM hourly_station_air_quality hsaq
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON hsaq.station_id = aqs.id
WHERE hsaq.datetime = '2025-10-05 14:00:00'
ORDER BY pm10 DESC
""")
df_pm10 = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print("PM10 concentrations at 2025-10-05 14:00:00:")
print(df_pm10)
print(f"\nTotal stations with data: {len(df_pm10)}")

# Get coordinates of station 17 (Causeway Bay)
query = text("""
SELECT ST_X(ST_Centroid(coordinate)) as lon, ST_Y(ST_Centroid(coordinate)) as lat
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE id = 17
""")
station_coords = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(f"Station 17 coordinates: lon={station_coords['lon'].values[0]}, lat={station_coords['lat'].values[0]}")

# Find road segments within 500m of station 17 and get their average traffic speeds at 2025-10-05 14:00:00
query = text("""
SELECT hrs.speed, rs.id as road_segment_id
FROM hourly_road_segment_traffic hrs
JOIN road_segment rs ON hrs.road_segment_id = rs.id
WHERE hrs.datetime = '2025-10-05 14:00:00'
AND ST_DWithin(
    rs.geometry::geography,
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(%s, %s), 4326)::geography,
    500
)
""" % (station_coords['lon'].values[0], station_coords['lat'].values[0]))

df_traffic = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(f"\nRoad segments within 500m of station 17 with traffic data: {len(df_traffic)}")
if len(df_traffic) > 0:
    avg_speed = df_traffic['speed'].mean()
    print(f"Average traffic speed: {avg_speed:.2f} km/h")
    print(f"Speed range: {df_traffic['speed'].min():.2f} - {df_traffic['speed'].max():.2f} km/h")
